Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Financial transaction record representing income or expense in the cash ledger

title.description: Title or source or recipient of money

receiptUrl.description: Receipt image URL or local storage path

voidReason.description: Reason given if transaction was voided

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Cashbook configuration profile, currency, language, initial balance, and public transparency preferences

description.description: Short group description or secretariat address

publicKasId.description: Auto-generated unique public cash report ID (e.g. KAS-8A49B2X7)

writeSecret.description: Locally stored 24-character group write protection token (never shown in public URL or viewer)

publicAutoSync.description: Whether to auto-sync changes to public_kas when online

publicLastSyncedAt.description: Epoch millis of last successful public report publish

publicBaseUrl.description: Base web URL for public read-only link

updatedAt.description: Last settings update timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable audit trail record of cash ledger mutations and voids

PublicKasReport.title: PublicKasReport
PublicKasReport.description: Public read-only snapshot of a group's cash summary and transaction history for real-time citizen viewing via a single link, protected on updates by a 24-character group writeSecret

writeSecret.description: Immutable 24-character secret token generated locally on treasurer device to authorize updates without requiring login

ownerUid.description: Optional treasurer identifier (may be empty when syncing without login)

groupName.description: Group / RT / organization display name (max 120 chars)

transactions.description: Newest-first array of up to 2000 public transactions containing id, title, category, type ('income'|'expense'), amount, date, notes

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Cash ledger transactions belonging to the authenticated admin

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Application settings and organization profile for the admin

/users/{userId}/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Audit trail records for transaction changes and cancellations

/public_kas/{publicKasId}.description: Public read-only real-time cash report accessible by exact KAS-XXXXXXXX ID without login; updates protected by immutable writeSecret
